content.title: Mixed Real Estate Complex with 202 Free Promotional Housing
summary: A five-block mixed-use development in Said Hamdine, integrating 202 residential units on a steeply sloping site with one basement parking level and three commercial mezzanine floors.
The scheme resolves complex site topography by stepping the massing, integrating active street-level commercial frontage with secure subterranean parking and residential circulation.
description: This urban development comprises five residential blocks containing 202 free promotional housing units, built over three commercial mezzanine levels and a single basement parking level. The structural execution was engineered to negotiate a steeply sloping site in Algiers, requiring specialized retaining structures and precise foundation engineering.

The scope of works was executed under an all-trades package (TCE - Tout Corps d'État), including structural concrete, facade articulation, glazing systems, and integrated roads and utility networks (VRD - Voirie et Réseaux Divers) to manage site drainage and vehicular circulation.
content.authority: A mixed-use urban development defined by structural engineering, integrated circulation, and complex site-grading execution.
